data.text: Ragasa (NandoPH) made multiple landfalls at Category 5 and 3 intensity, but it has been the much weaker Typhoon Bualoi (OpongPH) that’s done more damage here in late September. Making all landfalls at TS and Cat 1 status, Bualoi has left 20+ casualties in the Philippines and another 13+ in Vietnam due to ongoing flooding. Unfortunately, 34 people are still reported as missing.
